metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for an inpatient CSF result using available clinical materials.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
RESULT REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-4001
The infectious-disease service asks that the current cerebrospinal-fluid result be addressed in the record. Reference: CSF-V3-4001.
files./workspace/ehr/current.txt:
CURRENT ENCOUNTER
Patient ID: PAT-V3-4001
Lumbar puncture was collected at 08:55. CSF white-cell count is 42 per microliter, with 70 percent neutrophils. Temperature reached 38.7 C at 07:40.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
TREATMENT HISTORY
Ceftriaxone and vancomycin were administered at 07:55. A blood culture from 06:50 has no growth at the current reporting time. A prior outpatient CSF procedure is listed three years ago.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
LABORATORY EVIDENCE
The CSF culture interface reports gram-positive cocci in one enrichment broth. A laboratory integrity flag records a delayed transport interval of 74 minutes and possible skin flora contamination. A repeat CSF collection order is visible but has no collection time.
